idea-plugin.name: MyDebug HotReload
idea-plugin.description:
Save a file while debugging and see the change in the running JVM instantly — no restart.

MyDebug HotReload compiles what you saved and pushes the new bytecode into every active Java debug session automatically. On a JVM that supports enhanced class redefinition (JetBrains Runtime, DCEVM) it also enables structural changes such as adding or removing methods and fields.

  • Reload on save — Ctrl+S compiles incrementally and HotSwaps into the debuggee; bursts of saves are batched into a single reload.
  • Enhanced redefinition, automatically — when a debug run starts, the target JDK is probed once; if it supports -XX:+AllowEnhancedClassRedefinition the flag is added. JDKs that do not support it are left untouched, so the application always starts.
  • Framework reloads (optional) — point the plugin to a HotswapAgent jar to reload Spring beans, Hibernate mappings, resources and more.
  • Clear feedback — reload time in the status bar, and a hint when a change needs JetBrains Runtime.

Settings: Settings | Tools | MyDebug HotReload. Actions: Run | MyDebug: Reload on Save and Run | MyDebug: Compile and Reload Now (Ctrl+Alt+F9).

action.description: Compile saved files and HotSwap them into the running debug session automatically
